a.lede: Ride-hailing company Uber is notifying nearly 150,000 drivers that attackers stole their data after breaching AI infrastructure provider Fireworks in early October. [...]
a.title: Uber notifies drivers of data breach affecting nearly 150,000 people

b.lede: The ridesharing giant said drivers' license information stored by AI cloud company Fireworks AI was stolen during a security incident.
b.title: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver’s licenses during data breach
